issues.on_page: Allowances for funds used during construction 51,387
issues.issue: AFUDC is a non-cash credit for capitalized interest/equity cost. Putting it in 'other' is defensible (no category fits; it is flagged for review). It is 51,387 of 1,843,558 business-type receipts. Someone could also argue it should be left out of receipts altogether as non-cash.
The page prints this line only as 'Other - net', so 'other' plus review is defensible.

issues.on_page: Contributions in aid of construction 37,854 (offset by Reduction of plant costs ... (37,854))
issues.issue: Contributions in aid of construction are capital contributions from customers and developers, not gifts. The pair nets to zero, so totals are unaffected, but the category is a judgment call (this could be business_type.other_financing).
